summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with one parametrized test covering all valid forms and every invalid branch. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (38 passed) under the shared venv. mypy, black, and ruff are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. One deliberate deviation: the pytest.raises line has no type-ignore because isinstance narrows the expected type; this needs a checker run to confirm. Nothing was committed.
